docs.title: About this demo
docs.text:

Info

docs.title: Account settings
docs.text:
Last updated: September 4, 2026

Use the account settings to manage your personal details and preferences.

docs.title: Update your profile
docs.text:
1. Open Account settings.
  2. Select Profile.
  3. Update your details.
  4. Select Save.

docs.title: Change your password
docs.text:
1. Open Account settings.
  2. Select Security.
  3. Select Change password.
  4. Enter your current password.
  5. Enter and confirm your new password.
  6. Select Save.

docs.title: Create a customer
docs.text:
Last updated: September 4, 2026

Create a customer record when you need to add a new organisation to Orbit CRM.

docs.title: Before you begin
docs.text:
Make sure you have:

  • Permission to create customers
  • The customer name
  • A valid contact email address

Warning

Always search for the customer before creating a new record. Creating duplicate customer records can result in inaccurate reporting.

docs.title: Create the customer
docs.text:
1. Select Customers.
  2. Select Create customer.
  3. Enter the customer name.
  4. Enter the primary contact email address.
  5. Select an account owner.
  6. Select the customer status.
  7. Select Create.

The customer record opens.

Success

The customer is now available in the customer list.

docs.title: What next?
docs.text:
You can now:

  • Add additional contacts
  • Add notes
  • Update the account status
  • Assign additional users

docs.title: Customer fields reference
docs.text:
Last updated: September 4, 2026

The following fields are available when creating or editing a customer.

Field Description Required Customer name The organisation or customer name. Yes Primary email Main contact email address. Yes Account owner User responsible for the customer. No Status Current customer status. Yes Telephone Primary contact telephone number. No Notes Additional information about the customer. No

docs.title: Customer statuses
docs.text:
Status Description Prospect Potential customer that has not yet purchased. Active Current customer with an active account. On hold Account temporarily suspended. Closed Customer account is no longer active.

Warning

Changing a customer to Closed may prevent users from creating new activity against the account.

Note

Status names may be configured differently by your organisation.

docs.title: Example - Create a customer
docs.text:
Last updated: September 4, 2026

This example shows how an account manager might create a new customer.

docs.title: Scenario
docs.text:
Northstar Engineering has agreed to begin a trial of Orbit CRM.

The account manager needs to create a customer record before onboarding can begin.

The customer details are:

  • Customer name: Northstar Engineering
  • Primary email: contact@northstar.example
  • Account owner: Jamie Taylor
  • Status: Prospect

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
1. Select Customers.
  2. Select Create customer.
  3. In Customer name, enter Northstar Engineering.
  4. In Primary email, enter contact@northstar.example.
  5. In Account owner, select Jamie Taylor.
  6. In Status, select Prospect.
  7. Select Create.

The Northstar Engineering customer record opens.

Tip

Examples are useful when a task contains several fields or business decisions that may not be obvious from the procedure alone.

docs.title: Result
docs.text: The account manager can now continue with the onboarding process.

Welcome to the demo product.

This section explains the basic steps you need to complete before you start using the system.

docs.text:

docs.title: Orbit CRM overview
docs.text:
Last updated: September 4, 2026

Orbit CRM helps teams create, manage, and track customer records.

You can use Orbit CRM to:

  • Create customer records
  • Update contact and organisation details
  • Assign customers to account owners
  • Track customer status
  • Search and filter customer records

Info

Orbit CRM is a fictional product used to demonstrate documentation structure and online help features.

docs.title: Customer records
docs.text:
Each customer record contains information such as:

  • Customer name
  • Contact details
  • Account status
  • Account owner
  • Creation date
  • Notes

docs.title: Common tasks
docs.text:
You can use Orbit CRM to:

  1. Create a customer.
  2. Update customer details.
  3. Change the customer status.
  4. Assign an account owner.
  5. Search for existing customers.

Note

The options available to you may depend on your user permissions.

docs.title: Troubleshoot customer creation
docs.text:
Last updated: September 4, 2026

Use this topic if you cannot create a customer record.

docs.title: The Create customer button is not available
Cause
docs.text: Your user account may not have permission to create customers.

docs.title: Resolution
docs.text:
Contact your Orbit CRM administrator and request the Create customers permission.

Info

You can still view existing customer records if you have read-only access.

docs.title: A customer with this name already exists
Cause
docs.text: Orbit CRM has found a customer record with a matching or similar name.

docs.title: Resolution
docs.text:
1. Search for the customer.
  2. Open the existing record.
  3. Check whether it represents the same organisation.
  4. Update the existing record instead of creating a duplicate.

Warning

Do not create a second record simply to bypass the duplicate warning.

docs.title: Cause
docs.text: The email address may be incomplete or incorrectly formatted.

docs.title: Resolution
docs.text:
Check that the email address:

  • Contains an @ symbol
  • Contains a valid domain
  • Does not contain spaces

For example:

name@example.com

docs.title: Changes are not saved
docs.text:
Try the following:

  1. Check your internet connection.
  2. Refresh the page.
  3. Enter the customer details again.
  4. Select Create.

Caution

Refreshing the page may remove information that has not yet been saved.

If the problem continues, contact your system administrator.
